correctness.rationale: For n>=4 each ternary length-n multiset has one or more heavy coordinates (multiplicity >=2), exactly 12 messages have only one heavy coordinate, and all remaining messages incur at least two monochrome-list incidences. Thus 2|C|-T <= H <= 3L and T<=12 imply |C|<=floor(3L/2)+6. For L>=6 the twelve one-heavy vectors and balanced two-heavy edge vectors with t_01=t_12=floor((L-4)/2),t_02=ceil((L-4)/2) achieve the bound: n>=ceil(L/2)+1 ensures all edge vectors valid and distinct, and mixed/pure traces each have load <=L. For L=5 the thirteen-word length-four deletion and injective, trace-preserving maximum-coordinate lift work for all permitted n. Equality at even L forces T=12,H=3L and every remaining word exactly two-heavy; no stronger uniqueness claim. Independent enumeration checked all six signatures, L=5..39 three permitted lengths, and the complete 2^15 subcodes at n=4.
correctness.verification: Independently authored distinct code-signature enumeration for 105 construction parameters and full n=4 exhaustive 32768-subcode capacity counts 3,6,9,11,13,15,15 for L=1..7. Validated heavy-coordinate incidence count, integrality and exact lift argument analytically; inspected CHECKER.py source rather than assuming reported logs.
